derived_from.fold_source: patchwork-quilt/gitpp-app worker.js @ fc77e734831e312729da834a88922f1f024e50a5 (core slice: validateSurface + applyDeclarationGate + derive — the same extraction the app's own surface.test.mjs performs)

task.claim.*.description: Claim on one task: the key is task.claim.<task-id>, and the value is the seat (agent or human) working on it.

release.freeze.description: A freeze window while releases are frozen — an object {"from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD"}; unset while releases are open. Set by override records.

deploy.hold.description: true while deploys are held; the reason rides in the record's reason field.

oncall.primary.description: The seat holding the pager right now, as a login or rota name.

berth.assignment.description: The berth the fleet is assigned under the current harbour plan, as a berth id (e.g. dock-7-winter).
